note: Howard County Conservation campground at Vernon Springs Park, near Cresco, up a winding road past Prairie's Edge Nature Center. Playground at the entrance. Sites ring a clearing on the wooded hill above the Turkey River, set back from the river behind woods. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 46 sites (17 drive-thru), 50/30 + water, showers, $25, first-come. Added May-Oct season. Not waterfront holds at the true loop; pin 450 m off.
flags: PIN: stored 43.3476,-92.1372 sits on the park's lawns ~450 m west of the campground. Imagery shows the loop of pads clearly; centre about 43.3486,-92.1318. Google's 43.3492,-92.1346 is also ~230 m off.

Waterfront: stored 'not waterfront' holds and was read at the wrong pin. The real loop is a clearing ringed by forest; the Turkey River is ~200+ m south through unbroken woods on imagery (Overpass timed out, so an estimate). The county's 'amid the scenic view of the Turkey River' and 'listen to the sounds of the Rock Rapids' are marketing about the setting and no official photo shows river from a site. The note's 'small adjacent lake' is ~600 m west beyond the road and park, nothing near the sites: dropped. Note's 'open field' corrected to a clearing.

County notice on the camping page: 'All HCCB campgrounds are closed for the season' is the ordinary end of the season, not a status. Google 4.6 from 14 reviews. Dump station not stated on the pages read.
